---
title: "Validation Report"
output: html_document
params:
  data: NULL
  mode: NULL
  report_title: "My Report"
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Access the data
df <- params$data
ref <- params$mode
report_title <- params$report_title

# Detect which human rater columns exist
human_cols <- c("Domi_nor", "Amelie_nor", "Vadym_nor")
available_humans <- intersect(human_cols, colnames(df))
has_human_pair <- length(available_humans) >= 2
```

### ====================================================
### ANALYSIS
# --- 1. RELATIVE BLAND-ALTMAN + sMAPE  ---
# human vs human
```{r 1, echo=FALSE, eval=has_human_pair}
analyze_relative_ba_sMAPE(df[df$Average_Human > 10,], "Domi_nor", "Amelie_nor", "Human 1 vs Human 2 (Relative)")
```

# human vs machine
```{r 2, echo=FALSE}
analyze_relative_ba_sMAPE(df[df$Average_Human > 10,], "Colonies", ref, "Program vs Human Reference")
```

# --- 2. DEMING REGRESSION ---
# human vs human
```{r 3, echo=FALSE, eval=has_human_pair}
analyze_deming_regression(df[df$Average_Human > 10,], "Domi_nor", "Amelie_nor", "Human 1 vs Human 2 (Relative)")
```

# human vs machine
```{r 4, echo=FALSE}
analyze_deming_regression(df[df$Average_Human > 10,], "Colonies", ref, "Program vs Human Reference")
```

# --- 3. CCC MATRIX PLOT  ---
```{r 5, echo=FALSE}
ccc_cols <- c(available_humans, ref, "Colonies")
# keep only columns that actually exist in df
ccc_cols <- intersect(ccc_cols, colnames(df))
plot_ccc_matrix(df[df$Average_Human > 10,], ccc_cols)
```
